RUINOUS.definition: Extremely harmful; bringing physical or financial ruin.

IRONS.definition: Metal shackles; for hands or legs.

ROSIN.gloss: any of a class of solid or semisolid viscous substances obtained either as exudations…
ROSIN.definition: Any of a class of solid or semisolid viscous substances obtained either as exudations from certain plants or prepared by polymerization of simple molecules.

IRON.gloss: a heavy ductile magnetic metallic element
IRON.definition: A heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood.

RUIN.gloss: an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction
RUIN.definition: An irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction.
RUIN.example: You have brought ruin on this entire family.

RUN.gloss: move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
RUN.definition: Move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time.
RUN.example: Don't run--you'll be out of breath.

SON.example: Their son became a famous judge.

SIR.gloss: term of address for a man
SIR.definition: Term of address for a man.

SUN.gloss: the star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system
SUN.definition: The star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system.
SUN.example: The sun contains 99.85% of the mass in the solar system.

ION.gloss: a particle that is electrically charged
ION.definition: A particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative); an atom or molecule or group that has lost or gained one or more electrons.
